participant_1.name: Evelyn
participant_1.personality: Evelyn is spirited and enjoys expressing herself through dance and social gatherings. She has a whimsical outlook on life and embraces her youthful energy.
participant_1.background: I'm very strong for my age. I remember when nobody had a television. I feel like I might live forever. I love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight.
